api.input: Only actual strict available RequirementRelationshipContextSchema; derive all witnesses internally. No caller edges/eligibility/proof flags. Parse fail closed.

output.binding: Exact source7, attempt, canonical/JD ID/revision/native SHA and policy/profile identities. Native SHA opaque; never recompute with JS serialization.
output.witnesses: Deterministic IDs, exact fact/current location/clause/offset/confirmation refs, tier, actor/action/object, exact approved-alias skill concept mapping, optional explicit full ISO interval; source vs declaration vs observed origin separate.
output.unresolved: Retain concrete missing/ambiguous/unsupported evidence reasons; never silently omit or claim unqualified.

supportedSubset: Exact skill facts yield listed only.
Exact current source quote with explicit single action/object and using <approved skill> may yield source_contribution.
Exact current owner-confirmed Responsible for ... using <approved skill> yields candidate_responsibility, never independent proficiency.
Explicit same-clause skill use with two valid full ISO endpoints yields claimed dated_use. No inference from job tenure/header dates.
abstain: Negation, future, conditional, quoted claims, ambiguous compound agency, pronouns, unsupported locale/domain/grammar
Year-only, Present or unbound job dates; co-location, generic confirmation and producer version do not prove relationships
Old observed ancestor value cannot establish edited current text; exact confirmed edits are declarations only
limits: Version and hash the exact bounded grammar/action/alias/date policy. Reject limits before expansion; preserve original text and Unicode offsets, no silent truncation. Existing raw writing IR is parsing support only, never ownership authority.
preserve: Legacy score engine/repository numeric policy and typed503 unchanged. No authoring unpause. No DB/flags/producer/storage changes. Full typed coverage/consumer comes next.

ownership.reviewer: Read-only finite source review; existing pricing_validation thread does no pricing.
ownership.root: Shared contract, synchronization, integration and one combined affected gate.

verification: Use actual existing grouped-import/evidence/canonical/JD builders through strict reader-shaped DTO and actual semantic producer. Essential positive tiers and exact-source/declaration counterexamples; binding/agency/negation/date/alias/overlap/limit controls. No hand-authored semantic outputs as substitute. No broad repeat campaigns. Author narrow checks then Root combined gate.
skillIdentity: Preserve exact JD literal operand matching for unmapped skills such as Python. Approved aliases add only explicitly declared equivalence. Output distinguishes literal-only identity from local mapped concept/alias; no inferred taxonomy. The two alias concepts do not restrict all supported skills.
inputValidatorAmendment: Backend may narrowly export validateRequirementRelationshipContext(raw,analysisId,ownerId,options={}) from adapter, extracting existing bounded/schema/status/check path and reusing it in unchanged loader and semantic producer. Validate IDs/options in exported validator. Preserve RPC dispatch/options/errors/all checks. No duplicate proof implementation. Original reader source gate is historical; next combined gate includes original88 and new semantic file due this affected refactor.
intervalSemantics: Preserve exact full ISO endpoints and source/declaration provenance; the grammar to DATE does not silently establish end-day inclusion. No FTE/proficiency or scalar year duration inferred. Coverage must later union only same-subject intervals and honor inclusive/exclusive JD bounds using exact Gregorian dates/calendar anniversaries, retaining endpoint/leap ambiguity. Disjoint-year comparisons need exact calendar boundary bands rather than365/365.25 averaging or floored months.
actualImporterAmendment: Real canonical import splits explicit Used <skill> from ISO to ISO source lines into date facts and genuine contribution fragments. Producer must support the actual path: a full bounded dated clause may be derived from the exact SAME current cited immutable source span, anchored by real fragment citation(s), never invented whole canonical facts/crossspan stitching/old-origin borrowing. Keep current fact/value/citations/confirmation separate from full immutable source-clause reference and offset space; confirming a fragment does not confirm the full clause. Preserve source-reported vs candidate-declared basis, clause identity/dedup and qualifier guards. Test through actual builders.
